facts.fact: Chad's finance ministry signed a five-year non-exclusive framework convention with Moov Money, Airtel Money, Konoom and Cashi-Tchad that lets the State pay salaries, bonuses or pensions through mobile money, and the finance minister said every civil servant could receive salary free by bank or mobile wallet.

TCD.note: The 1.2 million active mobile money users and 715,000 bank clients are counts of users and clients, not a survey share of adults.

facts.fact: Chad's finance minister said the country already has around 1.2 million active users of mobile financial services, served by operators including Moov Money, Airtel Money, Konoom and Cashi-Tchad.

Chad's finance ministry signed a five-year convention with mobile money operators to let taxpayers pay taxes, customs duties and public fees by mobile money, with collected funds available in the Treasury wallet and moved to Treasury accounts within 72 working hours.
